outcome_definition: Outcome = copies per uL of ONE probe assay in a ddPCR reaction, measured on a common gravimetric dilution series of E. coli O157:H7 gDNA. Each row is one replicate (day x replicate); every row carries all three replicates. Three cells (rfbE L5 day 2, stx2 L1 days 2 and 3) are blank in the supplementary PDF and are DROPPED, not imputed, so 102 of the 105 possible cells survive and each (assay, level) has 2 or 3 replicates.
